title: Pig Latin - Group By Major and Count
description: Groups records by academic major and computes student counts per discipline.
code:
-- Big Data Online Lab: Pig Latin Practicals
-- Practical 03: Grouping Records and Counting

students = LOAD 'students.csv' USING PigStorage(',') AS (
    id:int,
    name:chararray,
    age:int,
    gender:chararray,
    major:chararray,
    gpa:float,
    credits:int
);

-- Group student records by their Major
grouped_by_major = GROUP students BY major;

-- Count students in each major group
major_stats = FOREACH grouped_by_major GENERATE 
    group AS major,
    COUNT(students) AS student_count;

DUMP major_stats;

title: Python - Big Data Analytics with Pandas
description: Reads students and employees datasets, performs statistical aggregation and summary visualization.
code:
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

print("=== Big Data Online Lab: Python Data Analytics ===")

# Load student dataset
df_students = pd.read_csv('students.csv')
print(f"\nLoaded {len(df_students)} student records.\n")

# Summary statistics
print("--- Summary by Major ---")
summary = df_students.groupby('major').agg(
    student_count=('id', 'count'),
    avg_gpa=('gpa', 'mean'),
    max_gpa=('gpa', 'max'),
    total_credits=('credits', 'sum')
).reset_index()

print(summary.to_string(index=False))

print("\n--- Honor Roll Students (GPA >= 3.8) ---")
honors = df_students[df_students['gpa'] >= 3.8][['id', 'name', 'major', 'gpa']]
print(honors.to_string(index=False))
